title: Off-Policy Corrected Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper_type_zh: 离策略奖励模型校正与刷新配方
best_for_zh: 关注RLHF分布漂移、重要性加权、奖励模型刷新和离线偏好数据的研究者
one_line: Retrains reward models on one fixed preference dataset using stage-specific current-to-SFT importance weights between blocks of policy optimization.
在 PPO 阶段之间，用当前策略相对 SFT 行为策略的重要性权重重训奖励模型；278,496 条偏好记录与标签不变，改变的是有效训练分布。
why: Separates preference-data acquisition from effective-distribution construction and makes the support, variance, behavior-likelihood, cadence, and evaluator assumptions of off-policy reward-model correction auditable.
inclusion_reason: Provides an open reward-model refresh recipe that constructs a stage-specific effective training distribution by reweighting fixed preference records, without presenting that reweighted distribution as newly acquired data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A standard RLHF reward model is trained on comparisons whose two responses were sampled from an SFT policy. Policy optimization then changes the response distribution. The reward model is therefore applied to responses unlike those that determined its training risk, and its own score can continue rising even after the policy stops matching the intended preferences.

The paper formalizes this as covariate shift under reward-model misspecification. The minimizer of the Bradley-Terry loss under the SFT response distribution need not minimize the same loss under a later policy distribution. Consequently, even with unlimited comparisons from the original SFT distribution, the ordinary reward-model parameter estimate, and generally the policy-gradient estimate built from it, can remain inconsistent for the current policy.

For data curation, the central object must be stated precisely. OCRM starts with one fixed preference dataset: prompts, two SFT-policy completions, and a winner/loser label. It does not obtain newly labeled comparisons from the evolving policy. What changes is the effective reward-model training distribution: at each refresh, the same records receive stage-specific weights derived from the current policy and the original SFT behavior policy.

This distinction matters because a refreshed weighted empirical risk is a construction recipe, not a newly collected dataset. The paper asks whether distribution correction can extend the usefulness of already collected preference comparisons while avoiding the cost of new samples and labels.

For this atlas, the reusable object is a disclosed, code-backed transformation of fixed preference records into stage-specific training views. That makes it an open construction recipe adjacent to reward-model methodology, not a released preference corpus, an on-policy data-collection system, or a benchmark. Missing immutable data and run artifacts remain part of the release boundary.

标准 RLHF 的奖励模型通常训练于由 SFT 策略采样的成对回复。随后,策略优化会改变回复分布。于是,奖励模型开始评价与其训练风险所覆盖的数据不同的回复;即使策略行为已经偏离目标偏好,奖励模型自身给出的分数仍可能继续上升。

论文将这一问题形式化为奖励模型设定有误条件下的协变量偏移。在 SFT 回复分布下最小化 Bradley-Terry 损失所得的参数,不一定也能最小化后续策略分布下的同一损失。因此,即使原始 SFT 分布上的比较数据无限多,常规奖励模型的参数估计以及通常由其构造的策略梯度估计,对当前策略而言仍可能不一致。

从数据策展角度看,必须准确说明核心对象。OCRM 从一份固定偏好数据开始:提示、两个由 SFT 策略生成的回复,以及胜者/败者标签。它不会从演化中的策略重新获取带标签比较。发生变化的是奖励模型的有效训练分布:每次刷新都根据当前策略和原始 SFT 行为策略,为同一批记录计算阶段特定权重。

这一界限很重要,因为刷新后的加权经验风险是一种构造配方,并不是新收集的数据集。论文要回答的是:在不增加样本和标签成本的情况下,分布校正能否延长既有偏好比较的有效使用范围。

从本图谱视角看,可复用对象是一套有论文说明和代码支撑的转换方法,把固定偏好记录变成阶段特定训练视图。因此,它属于与奖励模型方法相邻的开放构造配方,而不是偏好语料发布、on-policy 数据收集系统或基准。缺少不可变数据与运行制品仍是其发布边界的一部分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Let the fixed comparison contain prompt s, preferred response a_w, and rejected response a_l, both sampled by the SFT behavior policy pi_1. For a later target policy pi_i, the exact pairwise importance ratio is

w = pi_i(a_w|s) pi_i(a_l|s) / [pi_1(a_w|s) pi_1(a_l|s)].

Multiplying each Bradley-Terry loss by this ratio rewrites the reward-model risk under the current policy as an expectation over the fixed SFT-sampled comparisons. Under the paper's support and boundedness assumptions, the importance-weighted empirical minimizer is consistent for the target-distribution reward-model risk as the number of fixed comparisons grows.

Exact correction after every policy update would require continual reward-model retraining. OCRM therefore uses stages: train or refresh a reward model for the current policy distribution, optimize the policy for a block, recompute ratios on the unchanged comparisons, and refresh again. The new model changes the policy distribution and hence the next set of weights, but it does not add preference examples.

Raw sequence-level ratios are high variance. In the language-model experiments, the implemented weight is flattened and relative:

w_eff = [P_current / (alpha P_SFT + (1-alpha) P_current)]^eta,

with eta=0.001 and alpha=0.9. This variance reduction deliberately reintroduces bias. The effective training distribution is therefore induced by the current policy, the fixed comparison support, and these hyperparameters; it is not an independently sampled on-policy dataset and is not released as one.

设固定比较记录包含提示 s、偏好回复 a_w 和拒绝回复 a_l,两个回复都由 SFT 行为策略 pi_1 采样。对于后续目标策略 pi_i,精确的成对重要性比为

w = pi_i(a_w|s) pi_i(a_l|s) / [pi_1(a_w|s) pi_1(a_l|s)]。

用该比率乘以每条 Bradley-Terry 损失,就能把当前策略分布下的奖励模型风险改写为对固定 SFT 比较数据的期望。在论文给定的支持集与有界性假设下,随着固定比较数量增加,加权经验最小化解对目标分布下的奖励模型风险是一致的。

若每次策略更新后都做精确校正,就需要持续重训奖励模型。OCRM 因而采用分阶段近似:先针对当前策略分布训练或刷新奖励模型,再执行一段策略优化;随后在未改变的比较记录上重新计算比率,并再次刷新。新模型会改变策略分布,进而改变下一阶段权重,但不会增加偏好样本。

原始序列级比率具有高方差。语言模型实验实际采用扁平化相对权重:

w_eff = [P_current / (alpha P_SFT + (1-alpha) P_current)]^eta,

其中 eta=0.001、alpha=0.9。这种降方差处理会有意重新引入偏差。因此,有效训练分布由当前策略、固定比较数据的支持范围及这些超参数共同诱导;它既不是独立采样的 on-policy 数据集,也没有被论文作为此类数据集发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The language-model pipeline begins by training each SFT model for one epoch. The SFT policy samples 278,496 response pairs at temperature 1.0. In the main gold-model setup, Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2 scores both responses and the higher-scored response is always selected as the winner; labels are not sampled from the Bradley-Terry probability. These fixed triples train the initial Bradley-Terry reward model.

The prompt sources are the TL;DR dataset packaged by the Huang et al. summarization-from-feedback reproduction and a modified Alpaca-Instructions dataset from Alpaca-Farm. For Alpaca, prompts longer than 512 tokens and outputs longer than 106 tokens are excluded, and the original SFT, reward-modeling, and PPO training splits are combined before SFT training and pair generation. Evaluation uses the filtered validation set, not AlpacaEval.

After a policy-training block, the implementation evaluates each fixed winning and losing response under both the current policy and the original SFT policy. Their joint sequence-probability ratio defines the correction. Reward-model retraining applies the flattened relative form with eta=0.001 and alpha=0.9 in all language-model experiments. Thus the raw records and labels remain constant while their contribution to the loss changes by stage.

The refreshed reward model is used for the next PPO block. The KL reference is moved from the original SFT policy to the preceding stage policy, because the refreshed reward model is intended to be accurate near that distribution. When the reward model changes, the PPO value-network parameters and AdamW optimizer state are reset. PPO rollouts use temperature 0.7; evaluation generation uses temperature 0.01.

Main OCRM runs refresh after every 100,000 generated policy-training samples and report two or three stages. A five-stage Pythia-1B TL;DR extension is reported for one seed. Pythia-1B-deduped and Qwen2.5-1.5B are the principal base models; a Pythia 6.9B experiment substitutes GRPO. These stage, KL, reset, and rollout choices are part of the released recipe, not fields newly added to the preference dataset.

语言模型流水线首先对每个 SFT 模型训练一个 epoch。随后,SFT 策略以温度 1.0 采样 278,496 对回复。在主要的 gold-model 设定中,Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2 为两个回复评分,并总是把分数更高者标为胜者;标签不是按 Bradley-Terry 概率随机采样的。这些固定三元组用于训练初始 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型。

提示来源包括 Huang 等人的 summarization-from-feedback 复现流程所整理的 TL;DR 数据,以及源自 Alpaca-Farm 的修改版 Alpaca-Instructions。Alpaca 处理中会删除超过 512 个 token 的查询和超过 106 个 token 的输出,并在训练 SFT 和生成比较对之前,把原本用于 SFT、奖励建模和 PPO 的训练划分合并。评估使用过滤后的验证集,而不是 AlpacaEval。

完成一段策略训练后,实现会分别用当前策略和原始 SFT 策略计算每条固定胜者、败者回复的概率。两个回复的联合序列概率比定义校正项。所有语言模型实验在重训奖励模型时都采用 eta=0.001、alpha=0.9 的扁平化相对权重。因此,原始记录与标签始终不变,变化的是各记录在不同阶段对损失的贡献。

刷新后的奖励模型用于下一段 PPO。KL 参照从原始 SFT 策略改为上一阶段策略,因为刷新后的奖励模型预期在该分布附近更准确。奖励模型切换时,PPO 的价值网络参数与 AdamW 优化器状态都会重置。PPO rollout 温度为 0.7,评估生成温度为 0.01。

主要 OCRM 运行每生成 100,000 个策略训练样本刷新一次,并报告两阶段或三阶段结果;论文还给出单随机种子的五阶段 Pythia-1B TL;DR 扩展。主要基座模型是 Pythia-1B-deduped 和 Qwen2.5-1.5B,Pythia 6.9B 实验改用 GRPO。这些阶段、KL、重置和 rollout 选择属于公开配方,而不是偏好数据中新增的字段。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest empirical evidence is a controlled comparison under the paper's synthetic gold-model protocol. On TL;DR with Pythia-1B, the gold-model win rate is 62.9 +/- 2.7% for PPO, 71.4 +/- 2.9% for OCRM with two stages, and 73.6 +/- 1.7% with three stages. This setting uses three random seeds, each with a different SFT model and resulting fixed comparison dataset. Other main table settings use one seed.

The same table reports improvements across model and task variants. For Qwen2.5-1.5B on TL;DR, PPO scores 80.5%, versus 87.7% and 89.6% for two- and three-stage OCRM. On the short Alpaca-Farm setup with Qwen2.5-1.5B, the corresponding values are 66.1%, 68.5%, and 69.5%. Larger Pythia results are also reported, but selected baselines are omitted for computational reasons.

Ablations show that the complete scaffold matters. On a Pythia-1B TL;DR run, PPO reaches a 59.6% win rate, PPO plus value/optimizer reset 60.0%, PPO with the new stage-local KL reference 67.5%, two-stage OCRM 68.6%, and three-stage OCRM 71.7%. The paper also varies fixed preference-set size, refresh interval, eta, and alpha; all tested weighting settings outperform the displayed PPO baseline, while larger refresh blocks perform better in the tested range.

In the additional experiment where GPT 4.1 Nano supplies both labels and evaluation, the reported win rates are 57.0% for PPO, 62.9% for two-stage OCRM, and 70.4% for three-stage OCRM. The authors mitigate observed position bias during evaluation by judging each pair in both orders and treating inconsistent choices as ties.

These numbers support a training-recipe claim, not a data-quality claim. Most labels and main evaluations come from the same Skywork reward model, and the GPT 4.1 Nano experiment likewise reuses one judge for labeling and evaluation. The official MIT repository exposes dataset preparation, labeling, density-ratio, reward-training, PPO, DPO, and WPO source modules and launchers, but does not provide an immutable release of the 278,496 labeled pairs or stage-specific weight snapshots. At inspected commit 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45, the launchers refer to a summarize_from_feedback_details directory absent from the tree, while the modules are under ocrm; therefore code availability is evidence of an implementation path, not an independently verified turnkey reproduction.

最有力的实验证据来自论文合成 gold-model 协议下的受控比较。在 Pythia-1B 的 TL;DR 任务中,PPO 的 gold-model 胜率为 62.9 +/- 2.7%,两阶段 OCRM 为 71.4 +/- 2.9%,三阶段 OCRM 为 73.6 +/- 1.7%。这一设置使用三个随机种子;每个种子对应不同的 SFT 模型以及由其生成的固定比较数据。主结果表中的其他设置只使用一个随机种子。

同一张表还报告了跨模型和任务的提升。Qwen2.5-1.5B 在 TL;DR 上,PPO 得到 80.5%,两阶段和三阶段 OCRM 分别为 87.7% 与 89.6%。在 short Alpaca-Farm 设置中,同一模型的对应结果为 66.1%、68.5% 和 69.5%。论文也报告了更大 Pythia 模型的结果,但因计算限制省略了部分基线。

消融结果表明完整训练脚手架具有影响。在一个 Pythia-1B TL;DR 运行中,PPO 胜率为 59.6%,加入价值网络与优化器重置后为 60.0%,改用阶段局部 KL 参照后为 67.5%,两阶段 OCRM 为 68.6%,三阶段 OCRM 为 71.7%。论文还改变了固定偏好集规模、刷新间隔、eta 和 alpha;所测试的加权设置都超过图示 PPO 基线,而在测试范围内,更大的刷新区段表现更好。

在额外实验中,GPT 4.1 Nano 同时提供标签与评估;PPO、两阶段 OCRM、三阶段 OCRM 的胜率分别为 57.0%、62.9% 和 70.4%。作者发现评估存在位置偏差,因此交换两个回复的顺序各判断一次;若两次偏好不一致,则按平局处理。

这些数值支持的是训练配方有效性主张,而不是数据质量主张。主要标签与主要评估大多来自同一个 Skywork 奖励模型,GPT 4.1 Nano 实验同样复用了单一评审者完成标注与评价。官方 MIT 仓库公开了数据准备、标注、密度比、奖励训练、PPO、DPO 和 WPO 的源码模块与启动脚本,但没有提供 278,496 条带标签比较或各阶段权重的不可变快照。在检查的提交 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45 中,启动脚本引用仓库树中不存在的 summarize_from_feedback_details 目录,对应模块实际位于 ocrm;因此,代码可用只能证明存在实现路径,不能证明已经独立验证出开箱即用的复现流程。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main technical novelty is to apply off-policy correction inside reward modeling rather than only inside policy optimization. OCRM interprets the stale reward model as a distribution-shift estimator problem and uses known language-model likelihoods to target the reward-model risk of the current policy.

This differs from collecting fresh on-policy preferences. RLP-SPG, one compared baseline, generates current-policy replies and pseudo-labels them; OCRM keeps the original SFT comparisons and labels fixed. It also differs from ordinary PPO-RLHF, which continues using the initial reward model, and from DPO-style methods that directly optimize the policy on a static comparison set. The paper argues that WPO's current-policy probability weight is not the correct density ratio unless the data-generating policy is uniform, whereas OCRM explicitly includes the behavior-policy denominator.

The paper provides an estimation-error analysis. With bounded loss and bounded importance weights, the target-risk excess loss of the weighted reward-model estimator is controlled by a Rademacher-complexity term scaled by the weight bound. This formalizes why support and weight magnitude are first-class audit requirements. It does not prove that the entire RLHF procedure reaches a globally optimal policy.

For this atlas track, the data novelty is conceptual and operational: the recipe constructs a new effective empirical distribution without constructing new comparison records. Each stage changes which fixed examples dominate optimization. Treating those weights as part of lineage makes reward-model refresh auditable while preventing an inflated claim that OCRM released a new preference dataset.

The practical contribution is broader than the weighting formula. Stage-local KL references, reward-model refresh cadence, value-network and optimizer resets, and released scripts form the executable scaffold. Ablations indicate that some of these choices contribute independently, so the complete result should not be attributed to importance weighting alone.

主要技术新意是在奖励建模内部进行 off-policy 校正,而不只是对策略优化做校正。OCRM 把奖励模型陈旧问题视为分布偏移下的估计问题,并利用语言模型已知的似然,把奖励模型风险对准当前策略。

这不同于重新收集 on-policy 偏好。对比基线 RLP-SPG 会生成当前策略回复并给出伪标签;OCRM 则保持原始 SFT 比较对及其标签不变。它也不同于始终使用初始奖励模型的常规 PPO-RLHF,以及直接在静态比较集上优化策略的 DPO 类方法。论文指出,WPO 使用当前策略概率作为权重,只有在数据生成策略为均匀分布时才是正确的密度比;OCRM 明确包含行为策略分母。

论文还给出了估计误差分析。在损失和重要性权重都有界时,加权奖励模型估计器的目标风险超额损失,由一个经权重上界缩放的 Rademacher 复杂度项控制。这说明支持范围和权重大小是必须审计的一等要素,但该分析并未证明整个 RLHF 流程必然收敛到全局最优策略。

对于本图谱的指定赛道,数据层面的新意是概念与操作上的:该配方构造了新的有效经验分布,却没有构造新的比较记录。每一阶段都会改变哪些固定样本主导优化。把这些权重纳入数据谱系,既能审计奖励模型刷新过程,也能避免把 OCRM 夸大为发布了新的偏好数据集。

实践贡献也不只是一条加权公式。阶段局部 KL 参照、奖励模型刷新节奏、价值网络与优化器重置,以及公开脚本共同组成可执行脚手架。消融表明其中一些选择具有独立贡献,因此不能把完整结果全部归因于重要性加权。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper's explicit limitation is that OCRM needs the SFT behavior-policy density for every reward-model comparison. This is available when the comparisons were generated by a retained, known SFT checkpoint. It is not generally available for pooled preference data from unknown or heterogeneous policies, and the paper leaves that extension open.

Formal softmax support is weaker than practical coverage. Later policies may assign high probability to response regions represented by few or no useful fixed comparisons. Importance weighting cannot manufacture missing examples. Large sequence-probability ratios also raise variance; the very small exponent eta=0.001 and relative mixture alpha=0.9 stabilize training by adding bias, so the practical estimator no longer has the exact unflattened correction guarantee.

Fixed labels preserve fixed mistakes. OCRM cannot repair a wrong synthetic preference, add evidence for a response mode absent from the pair set, or reveal a judge criterion not represented by Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2. Using the same gold reward model to label and evaluate most runs can reward evaluator-specific agreement. The GPT 4.1 Nano study changes the evaluator but still uses one model for both roles; neither setup substitutes for human validation.

The stagewise algorithm is approximate. Reward-model retraining after every policy update is considered infeasible, but long intervals allow renewed drift. Short intervals interact badly with value-network resets because advantage estimates are initially inaccurate. The full method also changes the KL reference and resets optimizer/value state; ablations show these choices improve results, which complicates causal attribution.

Evidence breadth is limited. Only the main Pythia-1B TL;DR result uses three seeds, while most other model-task cells and ablations use one. Hyperparameters were not extensively tuned, some large-model baselines were omitted for compute reasons, and the five-stage extension is a single-seed result. An Alpaca-Farm analysis reports average semantic clusters decreasing from 11.90 for PPO to 11.72 and 11.31 for two- and three-stage OCRM.

Release auditability remains partial. Code is available under MIT, but there is no tagged release, immutable labeled-pair snapshot, stage-weight archive, effective-sample-size report, or unified upstream-license manifest. At inspected commit 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45, the shell launchers use a module-directory name not present in the repository tree, so a reproducer must first reconcile it with the available ocrm package. Decontamination is undisclosed. Reproducing the claimed effective distribution therefore requires regenerating data and trusting the exact checkpoints, tokenization, log-probability conventions, and stage configuration.

论文明确指出,OCRM 需要获得每条奖励模型比较数据在 SFT 行为策略下的密度。如果比较对由一个已保留、已知的 SFT 检查点生成,这一信息可以计算;但对于来自未知或异构策略的汇总偏好数据,通常无法取得,论文也把这一扩展留作开放问题。

形式上的 softmax 支持并不等同于实际覆盖。后续策略可能把较高概率分配给固定比较集中极少或没有有效代表的回复区域,而重要性加权无法凭空制造缺失样本。序列概率比过大还会带来高方差;很小的指数 eta=0.001 与相对混合参数 alpha=0.9 通过引入偏差稳定训练,因此实际估计器不再具备未扁平化精确校正的同一保证。

固定标签也会保留固定错误。OCRM 无法修正错误的合成偏好,不能为比较集中不存在的回复模式补充证据,也无法揭示 Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2 未体现的评审标准。多数运行由同一个 gold 奖励模型负责标注和评估,可能奖励对该评估器的特定适配。GPT 4.1 Nano 实验更换了评估器,但仍由一个模型兼任两种角色;两种设置都不能替代人工验证。

分阶段算法只是近似。论文认为每次策略更新后重训奖励模型在计算上不可行,但间隔过长会重新产生漂移;间隔过短又会与价值网络重置发生不良交互,因为初期优势估计并不准确。完整方法还改变 KL 参照并重置优化器和价值网络状态;消融表明这些选择也能提升结果,因此因果归因并不单纯。

证据覆盖范围有限。只有主要 Pythia-1B TL;DR 结果使用三个随机种子,多数其他模型任务单元和消融只使用一个。论文没有进行广泛超参数调优,因计算限制省略了部分大模型基线,五阶段扩展也只是单种子结果。Alpaca-Farm 分析中,PPO 的平均语义簇数为 11.90,而两阶段、三阶段 OCRM 分别降至 11.72 与 11.31。

发布层面的可审计性仍不完整。代码采用 MIT 许可,但没有带版本标签的发布、不可变的带标签比较快照、阶段权重存档、有效样本量报告或统一的上游许可清单。在检查的提交 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45 中,shell 启动脚本使用仓库树中不存在的模块目录名,复现者必须先把它与实际存在的 ocrm 包对应起来;去污染信息也未披露。要复现论文所称的有效分布,仍需重新生成数据,并依赖完全一致的检查点、分词、对数概率约定和阶段配置。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, this paper is useful as a recipe for transforming a fixed preference corpus into stage-specific reward-model training views. It broadens data construction beyond acquisition: provenance includes not only which records exist, but also which policy induces their effective weights at each training stage.

The recipe is directly relevant to reward modeling and preference learning when a team retains the behavior-policy checkpoint that generated its comparisons. It offers a controlled alternative to paying for repeated on-policy labels. It is not evidence that old data always replaces new data, and it should not be categorized as an SFT corpus, an on-policy preference release, or a general-purpose reward dataset.

Useful applications include:

  • reproducing OCRM on TL;DR or the filtered Alpaca-Instructions setup using the official scripts;
  • comparing fixed-data reweighting against fresh on-policy collection or pseudo-labeling at matched compute and label cost;
  • auditing weight tails, effective sample size, support coverage, and label-error amplification across policy stages;
  • testing whether alternative ratio clipping, flattening, or relative weighting improves the variance-bias trade-off;
  • studying refresh cadence jointly with value-network recovery, KL reference choice, and optimizer resets;
  • extending the method to comparison pools generated by multiple known behavior policies.

A well-formed downstream artifact should keep two layers separate. The canonical dataset layer contains the unchanged prompt, chosen response, rejected response, and label. A run-specific layer records behavior/current log probabilities, raw ratios, transformed weights, stage policy identifiers, and reward-model checkpoints. Without the second layer, the effective distribution is not reproducible; without the first, the weighting lineage is uninterpretable.

对于 data_construction_open_release_recipes 赛道,这篇论文提供了一种把固定偏好语料转换为阶段特定奖励模型训练视图的配方。它把数据构造从"获取哪些记录"扩展到"每一训练阶段由哪个策略决定这些记录的有效权重",因此数据谱系不仅包括样本本身,也包括权重诱导过程。

当团队保留了生成比较数据的行为策略检查点时,该配方可直接用于奖励建模与偏好学习,并提供一种不必反复支付 on-policy 标注成本的受控方案。但它不能证明旧数据总能替代新数据,也不应被归类为 SFT 语料、on-policy 偏好数据发布或通用奖励数据集。

可用于以下工作:

  • 使用官方脚本在 TL;DR 或过滤后的 Alpaca-Instructions 设置中复现 OCRM;
  • 在计算和标注成本相当时,对比固定数据重加权、重新收集 on-policy 数据以及伪标注;
  • 跨策略阶段审计权重尾部、有效样本量、支持覆盖和标签错误放大;
  • 测试其他比率裁剪、扁平化或相对加权方案的方差—偏差权衡;
  • 联合研究刷新节奏、价值网络恢复、KL 参照选择和优化器重置;
  • 扩展到由多个已知行为策略生成的比较池。

规范的下游制品应明确分成两层。规范数据层保存不变的提示、偏好回复、拒绝回复与标签;运行特定层记录行为/当前策略对数概率、原始比率、变换后权重、阶段策略标识和奖励模型检查点。缺少第二层,就无法复现有效分布;缺少第一层,权重的数据谱系也无法解释。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Data identity: 278,496 prompt-response pairs are generated once by one-epoch SFT policies at temperature 1.0 and receive one synthetic winner/loser label. PPO rollouts train the policy, but OCRM refreshes do not append those rollouts or new labels to this fixed comparison set.
  • What changes: current-policy likelihoods, joint current-to-SFT ratios, transformed loss weights, reward-model parameters, and policy checkpoints change by stage. The exact pair ratio uses the probability product for both responses; language-model runs apply the flattened relative transform with eta=0.001 and alpha=0.9.
  • Feedback and cadence: Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2 labels and evaluates the main experiments; GPT 4.1 Nano is used in one additional experiment. Main runs refresh after 100,000 policy-training samples, move the KL reference to the previous policy, and reset the PPO value network and optimizer state.
  • Sampling and evidence: temperatures are 1.0 for fixed-pair generation, 0.7 for PPO rollouts, and 0.01 for evaluation. Only the main Pythia-1B TL;DR comparison uses three seeds; most other settings are single-seed and synthetic-judge based, so performance does not establish preference-data quality.
  • Release and audit boundary: official MIT code and processed prompt links are available, but the repository has no tagged release and provides no immutable fixed-pair data, stage weights, run logs, or integrated license manifest. At inspected commit 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45, launcher paths do not match the ocrm module directory. Support coverage, weight tails, effective sample size, behavior-policy reproducibility, label errors, decontamination, independent evaluation, and diversity remain open.

• 数据身份: 训练一个 epoch 的 SFT 策略以温度 1.0 一次性生成 278,496 条提示—回复对,并为每条记录赋予一个合成胜者/败者标签。PPO rollout 用于训练策略,但 OCRM 刷新不会把这些 rollout 或新标签追加到固定比较集中。
  • 变化对象: 当前策略似然、当前策略相对 SFT 的联合比率、变换后损失权重、奖励模型参数和策略检查点随阶段变化。精确成对比率使用两个回复的概率乘积,语言模型运行再应用 eta=0.001、alpha=0.9 的扁平化相对变换。
  • 反馈与节奏: 主要实验由 Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2 标注并评估,另有一个实验使用 GPT 4.1 Nano。主要运行每生成 100,000 个策略训练样本刷新一次,将 KL 参照移到上一阶段策略,并重置 PPO 价值网络和优化器状态。
  • 采样与证据: 固定比较对生成、PPO rollout 和评估生成的温度分别为 1.0、0.7 和 0.01。只有主要 Pythia-1B TL;DR 比较使用三个随机种子;多数其他设置为单种子且依赖合成评审,因此性能不能证明偏好数据质量。
  • 发布与审计边界: 官方 MIT 代码和处理后提示数据链接可用,但仓库没有带版本标签的发布,也没有固定比较数据、阶段权重、运行日志或整合许可清单的不可变快照。在检查的提交 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45 中,启动脚本路径与 ocrm 模块目录不一致。支持覆盖、权重尾部、有效样本量、行为策略复现、标签错误、去污染、独立评估和多样性仍待审计。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Use the official OpenReview record for the venue citation:

``bibtex @inproceedings{ackermann2025off_policy, title = {Off-Policy Corrected Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback}, author = {Johannes Ackermann and Takashi Ishida and Masashi Sugiyama}, booktitle = {Conference on Language Modeling (COLM)}, year = {2025}, url = {https://openreview.net/forum?id=0zxugBcgF5} } ``

The official repository provides the same title, authors, year, and OpenReview identifier; arXiv:2507.15507 is the public preprint record. Implementation inspection for this card used commit 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45 (https://github.com/JohannesAck/OffPolicyCorrectedRewardModeling/commit/89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45). The repository reports an MIT license and no published release; it links processed prompt datasets, but not an immutable release of the generated labeled pairs or stage weights.

会议论文引用应以官方 OpenReview 记录为准:

``bibtex @inproceedings{ackermann2025off_policy, title = {Off-Policy Corrected Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback}, author = {Johannes Ackermann and Takashi Ishida and Masashi Sugiyama}, booktitle = {Conference on Language Modeling (COLM)}, year = {2025}, url = {https://openreview.net/forum?id=0zxugBcgF5} } ``

官方代码仓库给出了相同的标题、作者、年份与 OpenReview 标识;arXiv:2507.15507 是公开预印本记录。本卡对实现的检查固定在提交 89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45 (https://github.com/JohannesAck/OffPolicyCorrectedRewardModeling/commit/89d4d19a41bcaa187c43dac2e23eb3fafba59e45)。仓库标注 MIT 许可且没有已发布版本;它链接了处理后的提示数据集,但没有发布生成后带标签比较或阶段权重的不可变快照。
